Assuage,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓpra-upa-Sam c. (Samayati), tuz c.; SAM(sAM)tv 10.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓpra-upa-Sam 4 P.
ⓃAssusive,Ⓒa.ⒹSAMtiprada, SAmaka.

Assume,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓgrah 9 P, Df 10, AdA 3 A.
Ⓑ
 2 Arrogate, q. v.
Ⓑ
 3 grah, sidDa a. man 4 A; pramARaM vinA vad 1 P; ‘a(ssum)ing to be true’ tatsatyamiti gfhItvApi; ‘a(ssum)ed silence’ kftakaM-miTyA-mOnaM.
Ⓝ[Assum]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹSee Arrogant.
ⓃAssumption,Ⓒs.ⒹgrahaRaM, DAraRaM.
Ⓑ
 2 kalpanA ‘on the a(ssumption) that he is a fool’ sa mUrKa iti matvA.
Ⓑ
 3 pratijYA; prameyaM.

Assure,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓprati-i c., pratItiM kf 8 U, viSvas c.
Ⓑ
 2 dfQIkf, saMstaMB 9 P or c., suniScita a. kf. (Oneself) prati-i 2 P; viSvas 2 P, niScayena kaT 10; saniScayaM-dfQaM-vad 1 P.
Ⓝ[Assur]ance,Ⓒs.ⒹviSvAsaH, pratyayaH, dfQaH pratyayaH, pratyASA.
Ⓑ
 2 sAhasaM, prAgalByaM.
Ⓑ
 3 viSvAsakAraRaM, pratyayahetuH.
Ⓑ
 4 yogakzemaH, aBayavacanaM.
Ⓝ[Assur]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹasaMdigDa, suniScita, asaMSaya, dfQa.
Ⓝ[Assur]edly,Ⓒadv.ⒹniyataM, nUnaM, Kalu, asaMSayaM, ‘I a(ssuredly) feel’, ‘I feel a(ssur)ed’ iti me niScayaH, dfQaM manye.
Asunder,Ⓒadv.ⒹpfTak, viralaM, vigata-pragata a.; oft. by vi; ‘throw a(sunder)’ vikzip 9 P, ‘burst a(sunder)’ vidIrRa &c.
